newsitem.title: USA: American Eagle sees Q4 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: American Eagle sees Q4 below estimates.

text.p: American Eagle Outfitters Inc said total sales for the four weeks ended December 28 declined 14.1 percent from a year-ago and same-store sales fell 16.9 percent.

As a result of this decline, the company said fourth quarter earnings will be below those currently expected by Wall Street analysts. Sales results for the full five week month ended January 4, will be announced the week of January 6th.

American Eagle noted it believes the decline in sales was the result of a combination of factors. These factors include the 1996 interim period having five fewer holiday shopping days; sales comparisons to the 1995 period, which saw a 11.3% same store sales increase; and a lower than expected sales performance in women's apparel.
